markdown:
The first time I travelled alone, I was nineteen and had saved just enough for a month in Spain. I didn't speak much Spanish and I got lost almost every day.

Looking back, getting lost was the best part. It forced me to ask for directions, to try the cafe on the wrong street, to sit on a bench and actually look around. I've travelled a lot since then, but I've never learned as much as I did that month.

labels.notes: "travelled" is the British spelling, also accepted in American usage; it should not be flagged in this en-US case. "cafe" without accent is fine.
